items.prompt:
The main point of an informational text is its:
A) central idea
B) title font
C) page count

An OBJECTIVE summary:
A) states key ideas without opinion
B) adds your judgment
C) is very long
items.answer: A) states key ideas without opinion

solution.answer: A) states key ideas without opinion

items.prompt:
A central idea is built and refined by:
A) specific details
B) the cover
C) the page number

steps: Details refine it. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

Renewable energy is reshaping the economy: solar jobs now outnumber coal jobs, and costs have fallen below fossil fuels in many regions.

The central idea is that renewables:
A) are reshaping the economy
B) are too expensive
C) create no jobs

steps: Main point refined by data. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Which is an OBJECTIVE summary of that passage?
A) Renewable energy is obviously the only smart path forward.
B) Renewable energy is reshaping the economy, with solar jobs surpassing coal jobs and lower costs.
C) I love solar power.
items.answer: B) Renewable energy is reshaping the economy, with solar jobs surpassing coal jobs and lower costs.

solution.answer: B) Renewable energy is reshaping the economy, with solar jobs surpassing coal jobs and lower costs.

items.prompt:
A central idea is SHAPED AND REFINED by:
A) the specific details the author chooses
B) the title alone
C) the font
items.answer: A) the specific details the author chooses

solution.answer: A) the specific details the author chooses

items.prompt:
Read.

Antibiotics have saved millions of lives, but overusing them has bred resistant bacteria, making some infections untreatable.

The central idea is that antibiotics:
A) are useless
B) save lives, yet overuse creates dangerous resistance
C) should never be used
items.answer: B) save lives, yet overuse creates dangerous resistance

steps: Both sides = central idea. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) save lives, yet overuse creates dangerous resistance

items.prompt:
Which sentence does NOT belong in an objective summary of an article on automation?
A) Automation has increased factory output.
B) Automation is a wonderful miracle everyone should embrace.
C) Automation has displaced some workers.
items.answer: B) Automation is a wonderful miracle everyone should embrace.

solution.answer: B) Automation is a wonderful miracle everyone should embrace.
